review_description: Greg has been really engaging and helpful. The system is great, meets our expectations and his workers have done a great job.Very impressed

Ours whole sales enquiry and process was great. Able to discuss various options to meet our needs and wants. On installation the crew arrived when they said were going to. They were polite and went about their work in a timely manner and cleaned up after themselves. The customer service since installation has been very helpful - only to happy to assist with any questions and working hard to get the electricity provider to install new solar compatible meter. Highly recommend.
